name: easyplate-webapp
description: EasyPlate on the web: sign in, account and Premium (Stripe), recipe viewer. Built into ../landing/app and served by Firebase Hosting under /app.

scripts.build: node scripts/check-i18n.mjs && node scripts/test-translation.mjs && node scripts/split-i18n.mjs && tsc --noEmit && vite build
scripts.preview:emulators: cd scripts/preview && mkdir -p .emulator && cp ../../../firestore.rules ../../../storage.rules .emulator/ && JAVA_HOME=${PREVIEW_JAVA_HOME:-$JAVA_HOME} firebase emulators:start --only auth,firestore,storage --project demo-easyplate --config firebase.json
scripts.preview:native: cd .. && flutter test test/store_assets/web_parity_screens_test.dart --dart-define=WEB_PARITY_SCREENS=true --timeout 120s && cd webapp && node scripts/preview/shoot.mjs --compare-only
